# nobus_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a Nobus volume to an instance.

After attaching, the provider waits until the volume reports the `in-use` status. On destroy it waits until the volume leaves that status again.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `instance_id` (String) ID of the instance to attach the volume to.
- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume to attach.

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone hosting the volume and the instance. Defaults to the provider `availability_zone`.
- `project_id` (String) Nobus project that owns the volume and the instance. Defaults to the provider `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `attached` (Boolean) Whether the volume is currently attached.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this attachment, formed from the instance and volume IDs.
- `volume_status` (String) Status of the attached volume, as reported by Nobus.
